### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Shuang-su/guangcai/blob/c709fcd938b7314cbbc4b59f9049c3b235a80bde/tools/cleanup-verified-folders.py#L50 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Run worktree removal from the repository** When this runs from the documented formal workspace, `ROOT` is `/Volumes/Prism_初号機/广彩/guangcai-v4-workspace`, so `CURRENT=ROOT.parent.parent` resolves to `/Volumes/Prism_初号機`, outside the Git repository. I checked the `git worktree remove [-f] ` help and confirmed that invoking a worktree subcommand with `-C` pointing at a non-repository directory returns `fatal: not a git repository`; consequently this call aborts the one-shot script before any `DELETE_ROOTS` files are removed. Run it with `cwd=ROOT` or an explicit Git directory. --- https://github.com/Shuang-su/guangcai/blob/c709fcd938b7314cbbc4b59f9049c3b235a80bde/tools/restore-source-folder.py#L41-L42 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Preserve executable bits when restoring a source tree** For a restored root containing executables, `write_bytes()` recreates every file with the process's default non-executable mode. A concrete affected entry is `prism-ceramic/guangcai-viewer/Start.command`, which `docs/history/20260921-original-git/manifest.json` records as mode `100755`, but a normal restore creates it as `0644`, so launching it directly fails with permission denied. Record and reapply source modes as part of restoration. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L11-L11](https://github.com/Shuang-su/guangcai/blob/c709fcd938b7314cbbc4b59f9049c3b235a80bde/AGENTS.md#L11-L11) --- https://github.com/Shuang-su/guangcai/blob/c709fcd938b7314cbbc4b59f9049c3b235a80bde/README.md#L17 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Refresh the post-cleanup archive totals** Fresh evidence in the final squashed tree supersedes the earlier review snapshot: `source-manifest.json` now contains 3,614 contents and 18,040 source occurrences, and the newly added cleanup completion records 11 LFS originals, while this paragraph still advertises 3,223/14,524 and 10 LFS files. Readers using the README as the archive entry point therefore receive totals that omit the commit's final cleanup import. ### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Shuang-su/guangcai/blob/bcfcac160a378e9b08d8aab7b63f443d725a5d60/tools/verify-source-collection.py#L19 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Validate the entire LFS pointer** When an archived LFS pointer is corrupted by adding extra content, this substring check still passes as long as the original `oid` and `size` lines remain, and the subsequent hash check reads the separate local object rather than validating the committed pointer. I confirmed with the installed CLI that `git lfs pointer --check` exits 1 after appending an extra line, so this verifier can report success for a revision that Git LFS considers invalid; compare the blob against the complete canonical pointer (or use the strict pointer check) instead.
